reference_transcript: Alright, um, this is gonna be a big one — Arms and Shoulders. Okay so, curls first: barbell curl, hammer curl, preacher curl, um, concentration curl, rope hammer curl, and, uh, Zottman curl too — yeah I know that's a lot of curls. Um, then triceps: cable overhead triceps extension, overhead triceps extension, and, uh, close-grip bench press. And then shoulders, um, dumbbell lateral raise, front raise, and, uh, reverse fly to finish. Okay that's, uh, twelve exercises for Arms and Shoulders.

meta.notes: 12 exercises, the hardest of the 5 — six near-identical curl variants back to back, plus 'Cable Overhead Triceps Extension' vs 'Overhead Triceps Extension' (one word apart), self-aware aside ('that's a lot of curls') mid-list
